home.title: Is your neighborhood flood-ready?
home.subtitle: Look up a Texas ZIP or tap the map. Demo risk scores help families and renters understand local flood exposure — not an insurance quote.
home.hint: Enter a 5-digit ZIP or click a map pin to see risk factors.
home.disclaimer: Demo scores only. Not a FEMA flood-zone determination. Do not use for insurance or legal decisions.
home.lookupError: Could not look up risk. Try another ZIP.

about.title: About FloodGuard
about.body: FloodGuard Texas is a public-impact portal in the TxBizFinder Intelligence suite. It helps everyday Texans see illustrative flood risk near them — bayous, coast, flash-flood alley — with a map-first experience.
about.sources: MVP uses curated demo zones for major metros. Future versions can plug in FEMA NFHL layers and NWS alerts behind the same lookup API.
about.suite: Sister apps: TxBizFinder, PermitRadar, ChannelWatch, Emissions Sentinel, PowerPulse Texas.
